kind: generic: the ARM types it makes are listed as azapi_resource:<type> rows and in "azapi_resource by ARM type" below
generic: see its azapi_resource_action:<type> rows and "Actions" below
Key Vault data plane (certificate contacts of a vault): a hand-written data-plane kind beside VaultCertificate; not built
a token password is the generateCredentials action's answer, returned once (c9): a hand-written kind that writes it to a Secret; not built

activating a directory role from its template (Microsoft Graph directoryRoles): a hand-written Graph kind beside DirectoryRoleAssignment; Graph activates a built-in role on its first assignment, so it is rarely needed; not built
Recovery Services protected item (backup for a VM): its path has a fixed backupFabrics/Azure segment the generator cannot own through; a hand-written candidate (docs/handoff.md h1.2); not built
actions on a subscription: resource provider registration, rename, cancel (POST); no desired state to own; not built
